purpose: Supplement immutable v1 with no-replace receipts, complete untracked/ignored hygiene, an opaque staging seal, an external publication anchor, exact direct-child finalizer execution, and a fail-closed archive receipt before assessment.

checker.role: Three-phase outcome-blind publication authority. It never wraps, parents, replaces or retries formal_abba.py. It launches only the already-frozen finalizer after the completed formal runner has exited.

v1_authority.immutability_rule: A2 imports the approved v1 checker bytes and calls build_pre_audit/build_post_audit. Neither v1 file may be edited, replaced or rehashed to accept drift.

pre: Verify A2 joint committed authority and exact v1 hashes before importing approved v1 bytes.
Require the frozen worktree to have zero tracked changes and zero ordinary or ignored untracked files, including sensitive source roots.
Call v1 build_pre_audit, embed A2 authority and hygiene, and publish once at the v1 fixed pre path using hard-link no-replace semantics.
publish: Require exact staging-subtree plus exact outer/host/source files to be the only ordinary or ignored untracked paths.
Snapshot all source-lock files, source lock, Julia Manifest and exclusive runner before and after v1 build_post_audit.
Publish the v1 post receipt once, inventory every staging regular file as opaque bytes while rejecting symlink/reparse entries, and publish a staging seal once.
Publish an external anchor once that binds the seal, inventory root, outer/capture/host/source/post hashes and exact finalizer launch intent.

Launch the exact frozen finalizer tokens once as A2's direct child with the fixed Python environment policy and publish its PID/command/exit/times in an external no-replace execution audit. A crash, nonzero exit, partial archive or existing path is terminal and numerical rerun is forbidden.
archive: Treat the external anchor and execution audit as the trust root, require exact finalizer command/cwd/PID/success and unchanged seal.

Rehash every prepublication inventory member, the v1 post receipt, capture metadata, audit copies, external observations, formal-run-manifest and every segment trace as opaque bytes without parsing segment JSON.
Require exact archive membership and publish one no-replace archive receipt. Assessment remains forbidden until that receipt says passed and assessment_authorized=true.

outcome_blind_attestation.allowed_observation: Canonical paths, Git state, byte counts, opaque SHA-256 values, process IDs, commands, environment policy, timestamps and non-outcome topology metadata only.

terminal_stop_conditions: Any authority, v1 hash, lineage, tracked, source, official-input, path, command, environment, PID or receipt mismatch
Any ignored or ordinary untracked path outside the phase-exact allowlist
Any symlink, junction, reparse, nonregular inventory entry, changed inventory member or unexpected archive member
Any existing receipt/output, no-replace race, crash, partial run, nonzero finalizer exit or missing official archive
Any attempt to retry publish/finalizer, resume or concatenate a numerical run, replace a receipt, edit v1, parse segment JSON or assess before the archive receipt
publication_rule: Only a passed A2 archive receipt authorizes the still-result-blind assessor phase. It does not authorize product connection.
change_rule: A2 amendment and checker are immutable after their joint pre-outcome commit. Any later correction requires a new numbered supplement and must never edit v1 or A2 expected hashes to accept drift.
